rationale.ai-review: Unanimous multi-model juries judge correctness of AI-generated SQL.
rationale.risk-routing: Unanimous verdicts determine automatic acceptance versus fallback to human review.
rationale.quality-debt: Execution-grounded experiments quantify incorrect AI-generated SQL across fifteen models.
rationale.framework: Reusable jury architecture combines independent judges through a conservative acceptance rule.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated the generation, judging, execution, and committee pipeline.
rationale.agentic: Complete generated SQL queries are reviewed as wholesale artifacts at a gate.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports functional-correctness failures and evaluates mitigation of false acceptance.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled tasks manipulate judge composition and measure third-party model behavior.
